_doc: Labelled pages for measuring whether a small local model can produce RUBRIC Depth. Labels are the Depth score the MAINTAINER would give the linked page after reading it — taken from reviews already written on the PRs/issues named in `why`. Deliberately article-shaped only: Depth for a tool's landing page means something different and is out of scope for this first measurement.
